title: A Vector for the Signal
author: Ines Iversen
blurb: Orsen Joubert, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
